ownership_summary: Public shareholding company listed on Boursa Kuwait and Bahrain Bourse (ticker KFH). government_link: Yes. Kuwaiti state entities (KIA, PIFSS, Public Authority for Minors Affairs) together held 31.58% at 31 Dec 2025 and have board representatives (S1, S4).
group_structure: Kuwait Finance House K.S.C.P. is the listed parent. It reports four segments: Treasury, Retail and private banking, Corporate banking, and Investment. It acquired Ahli United Bank B.S.C. in 2022. AUB Bahrain was renamed Kuwait Finance House B.S.C. (c) ('KFH Bahrain') on 10 Jul 2025. KFH Bahrain is 100% owned, is profiled separately as bh-kfhbahrain, and is itself the holding company of KFH PLC (UK), KFH Bank Egypt (95.7%) and Commercial Islamic Bank of Iraq (85.3%). DOUBLE COUNTING: KFH Bahrain's assets, deposits and profit (USD 29.0bn assets at 30 Jun 2026), including its UK, Egypt and Iraq subsidiaries, are fully consolidated in KFH group figures. Never add bh-kfhbahrain to kw-kfh totals. Other main subsidiaries: Kuveyt Turk (58%), KFH Malaysia (100%), Saudi Kuwait Finance House (100%), and KFH Capital (99.9%, effectively 100%; asset management, investment banking and brokerage, not profiled separately, so its AUM claim and people are recorded here with scope 'Subsidiary: KFH Capital').

capabilities.wealth_summary: Wealth sits in a Group Private Banking & Wealth Management (PBWM) unit under Deputy Group CEO Alexander Liddle. In 2025 KFH brought local private banking units across markets under that unit, launched a global multi-asset discretionary portfolio management (DPM) service and the international brand 'KFH Private', and approved a 2026 PBWM 'strategic reset' (brand refresh, network expansion, open-architecture solutions, a digital backbone for RMs). In Kuwait, Private Banking is by invitation, with Premium (KD 3,000 salary or KD 100,000-299,999 balance) and Advance tiers below it. Investment products come from KFH Capital (funds incl. US real estate, PE, REITs; it claims over USD 12bn AUM, undated), KFH Brokerage, the KFH Trade platform (Kuwait, KSA, UAE, Qatar, US) and the KFH Wealth app (2025). Group portfolio tooling runs on an Advent platform hosted at KFH Bahrain, which has its own PBWM franchise (see bh-kfhbahrain).

private_banking.detail: Group PBWM under Deputy Group CEO Alexander Liddle; Kuwait PB led by GM Hamad Alghannam. Dedicated RMs, dedicated branches (including ladies' branches), Visa Infinite and Oasis Club cards, Shariah-compliant financing (Murabaha, Ijara, Istisna'a, Tawarruq), and investment through KFH Capital. In 2025 local PB activities across markets were consolidated under the Group PBWM umbrella. The 'KFH Private' international brand was launched (Euromoney), and KFH UK held a London PBWM reception in 2025 stating that modern investment management services will be introduced. Awards in 2026: Global Private Banker (Best Private Bank Kuwait, Best for Islamic Services, Best for Discretionary Portfolios Kuwait) and Euromoney (Kuwait's Best Private Bank, Middle East's Safest Private Bank).

asset_management.detail: KFH Capital Investment Company K.S.C. (Closed), 99.9% held (effectively 100%). It offers public and private placement funds, money market funds in KWD and USD, public equity funds, REITs, private equity and venture capital. In 2025 it launched two US real estate funds of over USD 145m and implemented a new asset management system centralising fund and portfolio management (Euromoney). The website claims 'more than US$12 billion in assets under management' (undated). Chief Asset Management Officer: Abdullah E. Alali.

brokerage.detail: KFH Financial Brokerage Co. (the group brokerage arm, under KFH Capital) was ranked first among brokers by Boursa Kuwait in 2025 and passed the Qualified Broker tests. KFH Capital launched an Equity Trading Finance product on Boursa Kuwait in 2025. The KFH Trade online and mobile platform covers Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and the USA and includes IPO subscriptions. The group also holds an Islamic brokerage licence carried as an intangible asset (KD 14.7m).

digital_investing.detail: KFH Wealth app (KFH Capital, introduced 2025; App Store id6502254646): remote portfolio monitoring and transaction execution, digital fund subscriptions and KYC updates. Also an investment portal, and the KFH Trade web/mobile trading app for self-directed equities. The main KFHOnline banking app offers Gold Account buy/sell (2.8 tons traded in 2025, online and in branches). No in-app robo or model-portfolio product found.

advisory.detail: KFH Capital offers 'Wealth Advisory' to individuals. PBWM uses a four-pillar advisory framework (lead RMs, investment specialists, financing specialists, account managers) per Euromoney. Alghannam describes advisory services delivered by experienced RMs, and KFH publishes quarterly 'Wealth Insights by KFH Capital' market overviews.

discretionary.detail: Portfolio management by KFH Capital ('a team of professional experts manage your portfolio and ... all investment decisions on behalf of you'). The group launched Discretionary Portfolio Management in 2025: a global multi-asset DPM on a unified house view and asset allocation model. It won Global Private Banker's 'Best Private Bank for Discretionary Portfolios - Kuwait' in 2026.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: There is no robo-advisor or digital model-portfolio product on the KFH, KFH Capital or KFH Trade sites. DPM is RM-led, using a house asset allocation model.

funds_platform.detail: Open-architecture range of Shariah-compliant investment funds within DPM. Euromoney says 'the All Funds platform' (introduced by KFH Capital in Kuwait) expanded access to Shariah-compliant funds. Whether this is the vendor Allfunds is not stated for Kuwait; KFH Bahrain names Allfunds as its fund partner (see bh-kfhbahrain). There are also in-house KFH Capital funds.

structured_products.detail: Not found on the KFH Kuwait or KFH Capital pages checked. The Bahrain subsidiary offers structured products through TFS (see bh-kfhbahrain).

private_markets.detail: KFH Capital has private equity, venture capital, real estate funds and REITs, and launched two US real estate funds of over USD 145m in 2025 (a Washington DC Class A office and three residential communities). PBWM clients are offered 'international equity and real estate funds' and leasing funds.

islamic_wealth.detail: The entire group is Shariah-compliant under its Fatwa & Shari'a Supervisory Board. Wealth products include Sukuk (KFH Capital arranged over USD 29bn of Sukuk in 2025 and started a Sukuk trading book in Apr 2025), Shariah-compliant funds, DPM and the Gold Account.

partners.what: Portfolio construction, risk management and rebalancing platform launched within the group, connecting KFH Kuwait and KFH Capital to the system hosted at KFH Bahrain. The vendor's legal entity is not named.
Euromoney says KFH Capital's 'All Funds platform' expanded access to Shariah-compliant funds for portfolio clients in Kuwait. Vendor identity not confirmed by KFH.

initiatives.what: Restructured local private banking activities across all markets under a Group Private Banking & Wealth Management umbrella, enabling the launch of Discretionary Portfolio Management and an expanded wealth management offering.
Launched 'KFH Private' as a dedicated international wealth management brand; adopted a four-pillar advisory model; launched a global multi-asset DPM.
KFH Capital introduced the KFH Wealth app (remote portfolio monitoring and transaction execution) and integrated trading, accounting, portfolio management and compliance into one platform.
Launched the Advent Investment Management platform group-wide, hosted at KFH Bahrain, and refreshed the PBWM app branding. The Aurora RM system added a Relationship Dashboard.
KFH Capital launched two US real estate funds totalling over USD 145m and an Equity Trading Finance product on Boursa Kuwait. KFH Financial Brokerage was ranked first by Boursa Kuwait.
London PBWM reception: the Group CEO said KFH UK focuses on private banking and wealth management and that 'modern investment management services will also be introduced'.
Approved a PBWM 'strategic reset' for 2026: brand refresh, activation of the full PBWM network, DPM plus open-architecture wealth solutions, and a unified digital backbone for relationship managers.
Abdullah Al-Haddad (ex-Group Chief International Banking Officer) appointed CEO of KFH Capital.
Appointed Lamya Al-Tabtebai as Group Chief Transformation Officer, a new standalone transformation role.

opportunities: Stated 2026 PBWM 'strategic reset' explicitly includes an 'expanded suite of open architecture wealth solutions' and a 'unified, digital enabled backbone to augment relationship managers performance' (S4, PDF p.36).

DPM and the KFH Private brand are new (2025) and being scaled across Kuwait, Bahrain, the UK, Egypt and Turkiye; the UK subsidiary has said 'modern investment management services will also be introduced' (S4, S18, S22).
No robo or model-portfolio product found; digital investing is limited to the KFH Wealth app (portfolio view, execution, fund subscription) and self-directed trading on KFH Trade (S16, S17, S19).
New Group Chief Transformation Officer (3 Aug 2026) and Group CTO (Apr 2025) are recent appointments, and KFH says it is building an AI-driven digitalisation strategy (S6, S4, S8).
Large affluent base: Premium and Advance tiers below by-invitation Private Banking; group operating income from Retail and Private Banking was KD 313.9m in H1 2026 (S10, S2).
barriers: Islamic-only group: every product needs Fatwa & Shari'a Supervisory Board approval (S2, S4).
Strong in-house manufacturing: KFH Capital (asset manager, funds, PE/REITs, brokerage, KFH Wealth app) and a new asset management system (S14, S18).
Group-wide Advent portfolio platform already hosted at KFH Bahrain (S4).
Wealth decisions are spread across Group PBWM (Liddle), Kuwait PB (Alghannam), KFH Capital (Al-Haddad) and KFH Bahrain PBWM (Kaiksow); the decision owner for vendors is not documented.
incumbent_vendors: Advent - 'Advent Investment Management platform' for portfolio construction and risk, hosted at KFH Bahrain (S4)
'All Funds platform' at KFH Capital per Euromoney; Allfunds is named as the fund partner in Bahrain (S18; see bh-kfhbahrain)
KFH Trade Android app package id 'net.directfn.prod.android.kfhtrade' suggests DirectFN as the trading technology. This is an inference from the app ID, not stated by KFH (S17).
